# Inquiry Removal

> Inquiry Removal is a nationwide service focused on reviewing and removing unwanted hard inquiries from Experian, Equifax, and TransUnion credit reports.

## Primary Services

- [Homepage](https://www.inquiryremoval.com/): Overview of hard inquiry removal, situations, process, pricing, and the free review.
- [How It Works](https://www.inquiryremoval.com/how-it-works/): The hard inquiry review, dispute, response, removal, and follow-up process.
- [Situations We Handle](https://www.inquiryremoval.com/situations-we-handle/): Common hard inquiry situations and the facts considered in a review.
- [Dealership Inquiries](https://www.inquiryremoval.com/dealership-inquiries/): Help for unwanted hard inquiries after dealership financing.
- [Pricing](https://www.inquiryremoval.com/pricing/): One-time service plans and the scope included with each plan.
- [Eligibility](https://www.inquiryremoval.com/eligibility/): Situations worth reviewing and outcomes that are not promised.

## Situation Guides

- [Unauthorized Inquiries](https://www.inquiryremoval.com/unauthorized-inquiries/): Review inquiries that were not knowingly authorized.
- [Identity Theft Inquiries](https://www.inquiryremoval.com/identity-theft-inquiries/): Steps to consider when an unknown inquiry may involve fraud.
- [Soft Pull Became a Hard Inquiry](https://www.inquiryremoval.com/soft-pull-became-hard-inquiry/): Review what was promised and what appeared on the report.
- [Duplicate Inquiries](https://www.inquiryremoval.com/duplicate-inquiries/): Review repeated inquiry entries and their context.
- [Unrecognized Inquiries](https://www.inquiryremoval.com/unrecognized-inquiries/): Identify creditor names that do not look familiar.
- [Incorrect-Person Inquiries](https://www.inquiryremoval.com/incorrect-person-inquiries/): Review an inquiry that may belong to someone else.
- [Authorized Inquiry Review](https://www.inquiryremoval.com/authorized-inquiry-removal/): Understand the available review when an inquiry was authorized.

## Company and Contact

- [Frequently Asked Questions](https://www.inquiryremoval.com/faq/): Answers about eligibility, timing, credit reports, and consumer rights.
- [Contact Inquiry Removal](https://www.inquiryremoval.com/contact/): Call Inquiry Removal at (602) 377-6626.

Information on this site is general and does not guarantee a deletion, timeline, approval, or credit-score change. Consumers may dispute inaccurate credit-report information directly with consumer reporting agencies at no cost.
